why: A technosphere is an energy budget. Sources carry power density, a CO2 intensity, a land footprint and a provenance tag. Waste heat is physics. Fusion and orbital collection are labelled invented. A Dyson swarm is not this cut.

sources.name: Biomass
sources.why: Firewood and crop residue. Power density is a field, not a plant. Carbon is already in the fast cycle so this source does not unbury rock carbon.

sources.name: Hydro
sources.why: Dams convert potential energy. Density is a reservoir plus a river, and the land cost is the drowned valley.

sources.name: Fossil
sources.why: Coal, oil, gas. Oxidising buried organic carbon runs the carbon cycle backwards. Intensity is a coal-plant sketch, not a well-to-wake LCA.

sources.name: Fission
sources.why: Thermal plants still dump heat. Land is the exclusion zone, not the fuel. No waste-heat exemption.

sources.name: Fusion
sources.why: Engineering, not a measured source. Waste heat still equals input. Do not treat this as a claim that fusion exists on the planet.

sources.name: Orbital solar
sources.why: Collectors off-world still deliver watts that become heat at the surface, or beam them elsewhere. Speculation. Not a Dyson swarm.
